title: Learning to Undo: Transfer Reinforcement Learning under State Space Transformations
abstract: arXiv:2611.23081v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transfer learning in reinforcement learning (RL) has shown strong empirical success. In this work, we take a more principled perspective by studying when and how transferring knowledge between MDPs (a source and a target) can be provably beneficial. Specifically, we consider the case where there exists an undo map such that applying this map to the target's state space recovers the source exactly. We propose an algorithm that learns this map by matching state feature statistics gathered from both MDPs, and then uses it to transfer the source policy to the target. We theoretically justify the algorithm by analyzing the setting when the undo map is linear and the source is linearly-$Q^\star$ realizable, where our approach has strictly better sample complexity than tabula rasa RL in the target MDP. translated_title: 学习撤销：状态空间变换下的迁移强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）中的迁移学习已经展现出强大的实证成功。在这项工作中，我们采用更具原则性的视角，研究在什么条件下以及如何在两个MDP（源MDP与目标MDP）之间迁移知识能够被证明是有益的。具体而言，我们考虑存在一个“撤销映射”（undo map）的情形，即将该映射应用于目标的状态空间可以精确地恢复出源MDP。我们提出了一种算法，通过匹配从两个MDP中收集到的状态特征统计量来学习该映射，然后利用它将源策略迁移到目标MDP。我们从理论上论证了该算法：分析了撤销映射为线性且源MDP满足线性-$Q^\star$可实现的设定，在该设定下，我们的方法在目标MDP中具有严格优于从零开始学习（tabula rasa RL）的样本复杂度。在实证方面，我们证明了这些优势可以扩展到该理论设定之外：在具有挑战性的连续控制任务和Atari游戏上，我们的方法……
tldr: 该论文提出通过匹配两个MDP的状态特征统计量来学习“撤销映射”，从而将源MDP的策略迁移到目标MDP，并证明在撤销映射为线性且源满足线性$Q^\star$可实现的条件下，其样本复杂度严格优于在目标MDP中从零开始学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes learning an "undo map" between MDPs by matching state feature statistics to transfer a source policy to the target, and proves that when the undo map is linear and the source is linearly-$Q^\star$ realizable, it achieves strictly better sample complexity than tabula rasa RL in the target MDP.
